task_title: Fix quest arrow bouncing and add minimap edge arrows

plan_review.notes: Concern 1: overlay inset math fixed (subtract INSET from rectangle half-extents vRX/vRY instead of from t). Concern 2: minimap geometry is Phaser-coupled; added axial rectEdgePt tests to cover geometry; full minimap unit tests deferred (non-blocking, no test infrastructure for Phaser). Concern 3: tracked-only minimap semantics are intentional product decision (single tracked quest, not all quests). Concern 4: added axial direction tests (straight up/down/left/right) and corner-threshold tests.
